fields.System.Title: INV-304 — Lock balance rows on concurrent moves
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want balance rows locked when a decision depends on reading them, so
that two operators acting at the same instant cannot both take the same stock.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a move that must check availability first, then the balance row is locked for
  • the rest of the transaction and availability is re-checked under the lock.
  • - Given a transaction touching several locations, then location IDs are sorted before
  • locking.
  • - Given two transactions locking the same two locations in opposite request order, then
  • neither deadlocks.
  • - Given twenty concurrent moves of one unit each against ten units of stock, then
  • exactly ten succeed and ten are cleanly rejected.
  • - Given a locked section, then it contains no external calls and no slow queries.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance |
| Risks | Lost update ([doc 09 §4.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); deadlock ([doc 09 §4.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); lock contention ([doc 09 §4.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | concurrency (mandatory) · load |
